annotation.title_clean: A conceptual governance framework for managing robotic process automation implementation challenges in insurance claims handling
annotation.title_en: A conceptual governance framework for managing robotic process automation implementation challenges in insurance claims handling
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pietersen, L-A.; Lefela, T.D.; Lamprecht, C.
annotation.venue: South African Journal of Information Management
annotation.summary_en: Journal article proposing a conceptual IT/data governance framework, mapped to COBIT 2019, for managing implementation challenges of robotic process automation (software bots) in insurance claims handling. Based on a structured literature review; unrelated to physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Develops a conceptual governance framework for RPA in insurance claims handling
Maps literature-derived guidelines to COBIT 2019 governance and management objectives
Integrates IT governance, data governance and IT capability theory
RPA governance must address detailed technical and operational challenges, not just strategy
